blocks.text: Har algorithm har qism ke masle ke liye munasib nahi hota. Algorithm ka intikhab masle ki khaas zaroriyat par munhasir hai, jaise raftar (speed) ki zaroorat, memory ka istemal, ya data ki nauiyat (nature).

Misal: farz karein aap kitabon ke ek chhote aur be-tarteeb (unorganized) majmooe mein ek kitab dhoond rahe hain. Behtareen tareeqa har kitab ek ek kar ke dekhna hai; yeh Linear Search hai. Ab agar kitabein shelf par alphabetically (haroof-e-tahaji ki tarteeb mein) saleeqe se lagi hon, to aap beech se shuru kar ke tay kar sakte hain ke kis aadhe hisse mein dhoondna hai, aur kitab jaldi mil jati hai; yeh Binary Search hai.

blocks.prompt: Be-tarteeb (unsorted) list ke liye kaunsi search munasib hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Linear Search, kyun ke Binary Search sirf tarteeb wale (sorted) data par chalti hai.

items: Algorithm data ke mutabiq chunein: be-tarteeb data par Linear Search, tarteeb wale data par Binary Search.
